Player's Guide

Your Path to Adventure in the Amaranthine Sea and Beyond

How to use this book

This book follows your character from the first choices to a continuing campaign. Begin with the procedures you need to play, then use the specialist chapters as references.

  • First character: Quickstart, then Character Creation, then Core Mechanics. Build your character and learn how to resolve an action before comparing every option.
  • Choosing abilities: Talents, then Magic, then Your First Magical Character. Read the prerequisites and costs of the options you choose, alongside their full procedure.
  • Between sessions: Advancement, then Assets and Followers, then Downtime. Return to these chapters when your character grows or makes plans away from the immediate action.
  • Finding a place in the world: World Regions and Cultures, then World Powers and Patrons, then Character Backgrounds. Connect your character to a region, people, and relationships. The Travel category contains the longer setting books.
